Bill.BriefDescription: Providing legislative oversight of WorkFirst and temporary assistance to needy families.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to legislative oversight of WorkFirst and temporaryassistance to needy families; and adding a new section to chapter74.08A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.08A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The WorkFirst oversight committee is established for thepurpose of monitoring the effectiveness of the WorkFirst program inpromoting personal responsibility among recipients and in helping themattain longterm selfsufficiency. The committee shall consist of thefollowing members: (a) Two members of the Washington state house of representatives,one from each major caucus, to be appointed by the speaker of the houseof representatives; (b) Two members of the Washington state senate, one from each majorcaucus, to be appointed by the president of the senate; (c) The director of the office of financial management; (d) The secretary of the department of social and health services; (e) The commissioner of the employment security department; p. 1 SHB 2312 (f) The director of the department of community, trade, andeconomic development; (g) The executive director of the state board for community andtechnical colleges; and (h) The director of the department of early learning. The members of the committee representing the majority caucus inthe house of representatives and the majority caucus in the senateshall serve as cochairs of the committee. (2) The WorkFirst oversight committee shall meet quarterly. (3) The WorkFirst oversight committee shall receive monthly writtenreports on the following measures: (a) Temporary assistance for needy families work participationrates; (b) The number of recipients enrolled in post-temporary assistancefor needy families support programs when such programs are implemented; (c) The number of recipients in sanction status; (d) The number of recipients receiving working connections childcare subsidies; and (e) Temporary assistance for needy families expenditures in eachmajor activity. (4) The WorkFirst oversight committee shall receive quarterlywritten reports on the following measures: (a) The number of recipients who exited WorkFirst and entered theworkforce; and (b) The percentage increase in earning capacity for recipients whoexited WorkFirst and entered the workforce.
